text:
carmen_cs: Quick heads-up — NovaGrid wants to shorten their 12mo renewal to 9mo and asked for a one-time 7% credit to help bridge budget timing. PO: https://proc.novagrid/PO-5812
derek_ae: Any ask around billing entity or currency?
maya_fin: Need ARR to compute. Also delegation: finance can approve up to 8% one-time credits; >8% needs revops. What's ARR?
carmen_cs: ARR is $84k. 9mo pro-rata = $63k. With 7% credit they'd pay $58,590. They want invoice after signature, payment via ACH Net30. Vendor code should be on PO but not visible in the link.
derek_ae: I'll ask procurement for vendor_code and confirm invoice entity. Also check if they require signer SSO.
peter_legal: If PO references another contract or unusual terms, flag here. Otherwise we can use the standard short-form amendment and DocuSign.
esign_bot: DocuSign envelope placeholder created: DS-9997. Waiting on "vendor_code" and "finance_approved" flags.
maya_fin: 7% is within the finance delegation. Provisionally finance_approved — please attach the vendor_code and confirm Net30/ACH on the PO. No Net60.
derek_ae: Procurement replied: vendor code VC-5501, PO PDF attached. They confirmed US billing entity and standard terms. No SSO requirement.
peter_legal: Uploaded amendment draft referencing MSA-NG-2020-03. Short form, term shortened to 9mo, one-time credit line item. No extra clauses. Link: https://drive.redwood/amendments/novagrid-9mo-draft
carmen_cs: Actions: (1) Derek attach PO + VC-5501 to CRM (2) Peter finalize amendment and attach to DocuSign (3) Maya confirm finance_approved in envelope (4) I send DocuSign and follow up for signature.
esign_bot: DS-9997 updated with amendment and PO. Envelope sent to procurement@novagrid.com at 2025-08-02T18:04Z. Envelope ID env_6b2f.
carmen_cs: Thanks all — I'll post when signed and then route invoice. :thumbsup:
